verdict.rationale: Tailscale's vendor-run coordination server is described as closed source and not self-hostable (comm-19, comm-4), so the core control plane cannot be self-hosted first-party. One user notes that every Tailscale client except iOS lets you configure the control server, which hints at a workaround with an alternative server (comm-3). Other self-run pieces such as on-prem nodes, subnet routers and exit nodes are only data-plane components. Missing for 10: a first-party self-hostable control/coordination server, documentation for pointing clients at a custom control server, iOS client support for a custom control server, and hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted deployment.
